sourceName: Cracker Barrel store locations (mixed: official newsroom + AllStays directory, cross-checked against OpenStreetMap POIs)
method: crackerbarrel.com's own /locations finder is a JS search box with no static list, so it could not be scraped directly. Addresses were taken from the AllStays Cracker Barrel California directory (an aggregator that lists CB's own published addresses and RV-space counts) and, for Reno, from Cracker Barrel's own newsroom press release. Every address was independently cross-checked by geocoding against OpenStreetMap/Nominatim and confirming a POI literally tagged 'Cracker Barrel' at that address -- this caught and excluded one bad address (a 'Barstow, CA' Cracker Barrel that a web-search summary asserted but that does not exist; the address it gave actually belongs to a Flying J/Denny's cluster on the same road, and no CA Cracker Barrel location list -- official or AllStays -- lists Barstow). A Rialto, CA location also turned up in the AllStays list but was excluded as out of scope: it sits on I-10/CA-210, not on any of the named trip corridors.
policyNote: Cracker Barrel corporate statement (quoted in a May 6, 2025 TheTravel.com article citing the company directly): "Cracker Barrel's policies have not changed. It's still a store-by-store decision," based on local ordinances and each lot's size/layout -- there is no chain-wide guarantee, and RVers are expected to ask a manager on arrival. Not available on crackerbarrel.com's own pages.

records.name: Cracker Barrel -- Camarillo
records.source: AllStays Cracker Barrel California directory, cross-checked via OpenStreetMap POI
records.notes: 560 E. Ventura Blvd, Camarillo, CA 93010, just off US-101 -- the closest Cracker Barrel to Ventura on this trip's corridor. AllStays reports no dedicated RV spaces at this location (regular lot only). Overnight parking is a store-by-store manager decision per Cracker Barrel corporate (see policyNote) -- ask inside before staying; this specific store's current stance was not independently confirmed. Lot grade, lighting and typical noise not stated by either source.

records.name: Cracker Barrel -- Victorville
records.source: Cracker Barrel address cross-checked via OpenStreetMap POI (amenity=restaurant, name=Cracker Barrel)
records.notes: 11612 Amargosa Rd, Victorville, CA 92392, on the I-15 corridor toward Barstow. OSM tags this exact address as a Cracker Barrel restaurant, confirming the location. Overnight parking is store-by-store per Cracker Barrel corporate (see policyNote) -- ask inside; this store's current stance not independently confirmed. RV space count, lot grade, lighting and noise not stated by source; expect I-15 corridor traffic noise.

records.name: Cracker Barrel -- Rocklin
records.source: AllStays Cracker Barrel California directory, cross-checked via OpenStreetMap POI
records.notes: 4630 Sierra College Blvd, Rocklin, CA 95677, at the Rocklin Station shopping center just off I-80 -- on the I-80 leg toward Truckee/Reno before the Sierra grade. AllStays reports 3 RV spaces at this location (unconfirmed by Cracker Barrel itself). Overnight parking is store-by-store per Cracker Barrel corporate (see policyNote) -- ask inside; this store's current stance not independently confirmed.

records.name: Cracker Barrel -- Reno
records.source: Cracker Barrel corporate newsroom press release
records.notes: 935 West 5th St, Reno, NV 89503 -- opened October 2023 per Cracker Barrel's own press release, the strongest-sourced location in this file. This is the trip's Reno-area endpoint stop. Overnight parking is store-by-store per Cracker Barrel corporate (see policyNote) -- ask inside; this store's current stance and any dedicated RV spaces not independently confirmed.
